steps.name: Validate toolchain and persist safe environment settings
steps.description: Verify presence and minimal versions of node, npm, npx, yarn, and pnpm; detect preferred package manager (package.json.packageManager, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, else npm); record versions to workspace/logs/env_versions.log; persist NODE_ENV=development only if not already set (system-wide via /etc/profile.d/react_dev_env.sh) and also write a workspace-local .env.local for CI/non-interactive agents. Use sudo consistently for system writes and ensure idempotency.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98494/Database"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/logs"
# Verify binaries
command -v node >/dev/null || { echo "node not found. Container must provide nodejs." >&2; exit 2; }
command -v npm >/dev/null || { echo "npm not found. Install npm in the container." >&2; exit 3; }
# npx may be provided by npm; test robustly
if ! command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "npx not found; ensure npm provides npx (required for create-react-app invocation)" >&2
fi
command -v git >/dev/null || { echo "git not found. Container must include git." >&2; exit 5; }
# Optional managers
YARN_AVAILABLE=0 && command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1 && YARN_AVAILABLE=1
PNPM_AVAILABLE=0 && command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1 && PNPM_AVAILABLE=1
# Versions
NODE_V=$(node -v 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
NPM_V=$(npm -v 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
NPX_V=$(npx --version 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
YARN_V=$([ "$YARN_AVAILABLE" -eq 1 ] && yarn -v 2>/dev/null || echo "not-present")
PNPM_V=$([ "$PNPM_AVAILABLE" -eq 1 ] && pnpm -v 2>/dev/null || echo "not-present")
printf "node=%s\nnpm=%s\nnpx=%s\nyarn=%s\npnpm=%s\n" "$NODE_V" "$NPM_V" "$NPX_V" "$YARN_V" "$PNPM_V" > "$WORKSPACE/logs/env_versions.log"
# Basic numeric checks: node major >=16 preferred (fail only if too old)
NODE_MAJOR=$(node -v 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's/v?([0-9]+).*/\1/' || echo 0)
if ! [[ "$NODE_MAJOR" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 16 ]; then
  echo "node ${NODE_V} found. Recommended: node >=16. Proceeding but some operations may fail." >&2
fi
# Determine package manager preference: package.json.packageManager > pnpm/yarn lockfiles > yarn.lock > pnpm-lock.yaml > default npm
PM="npm"
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/package.json" ]; then
  PM_FIELD=$(node -e 'try{const j=require("'"$WORKSPACE/package.json"'");console.log(j.packageManager||"")}catch(e){console.log("")}' 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  case "$PM_FIELD" in
    *pnpm*) PM="pnpm";;
    *yarn*) PM="yarn";;
    *npm*) PM="npm";;
  esac
fi
[ -f "$WORKSPACE/yarn.lock" ] && PM="yarn"
[ -f "$WORKSPACE/pnpm-lock.yaml" ] && PM="pnpm"
# Persist NODE_ENV only if not already set; write both system and workspace-local files idempotently
PROFILE_FILE=/etc/profile.d/react_dev_env.sh
TMP=$(mktemp)
cat > "$TMP" <<'EOF'
# React dev environment: export NODE_ENV only if not already set
if [ -z "${NODE_ENV-}" ]; then
  export NODE_ENV=development
fi
EOF
# Use sudo consistently for file ops
if ! sudo test -f "$PROFILE_FILE" || ! sudo cmp -s "$TMP" "$PROFILE_FILE"; then
  sudo install -m 0644 "$TMP" "$PROFILE_FILE"
fi
rm -f "$TMP"
# Also write a workspace-local env file for CI agents to source (idempotent)
[ -f "$WORKSPACE/.env.local" ] || cat > "$WORKSPACE/.env.local" <<'EOF'
NODE_ENV=development
REACT_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:3001/api
EOF
# Record detected package manager
echo "PACKAGE_MANAGER=$PM" > "$WORKSPACE/logs/package_manager.txt"
exit 0

steps.name: Scaffold or detect existing project and record toolchain
steps.description: If the workspace is empty, bootstrap a JS React project using create-react-app non-interactively (via npx without deprecated flags) pinned to a stable version if available; if package.json exists, detect toolchain (create-react-app/react-scripts, vite, next, pnpm) and restore dependencies using lockfiles. Always write detected toolchain to workspace/logs/toolchain.txt and scaffold.log. If non-CRA toolchain is detected, record and exit so downstream steps adapt or fail fast.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98494/Database"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
LOG="$WORKSPACE/logs/scaffold.log"
: >"$LOG"
# If empty workspace -> scaffold CRA via npx (avoid deprecated flags)
if [ ! -f package.json ] && [ -z "$(ls -A . 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
  # prefer npx if available, fall back to global create-react-app
  if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if ! npx create-react-app@latest . --use-npm --silent >"$LOG" 2>&1; then
      # fallback to global binary if present
      if command -v create-react-app >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        create-react-app . --use-npm >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "create-react-app failed; see $LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 7; }
      else
        echo "create-react-app failed and no global create-react-app available; see $LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 7
      fi
    fi
  else
    if command -v create-react-app >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      create-react-app . --use-npm >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "create-react-app failed; see $LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 7; }
    else
      echo "npx and create-react-app not available; cannot scaffold" >&2; exit 8
    fi
  fi
  echo "CRA" > "$WORKSPACE/logs/toolchain.txt"
  echo "REACT_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:3001/api" > "$WORKSPACE/.env.local"
  exit 0
fi
# If package.json exists, detect toolchain safely
if [ -f package.json ]; then
  TOOLCHAIN=$(node -e 'try{const j=require("./package.json");const deps=Object.assign({},j.dependencies||{},j.devDependencies||{});if(deps["react-scripts"])console.log("CRA");else if(deps["next"])console.log("NEXT");else if(deps["vite"])console.log("VITE");else console.log("OTHER");}catch(e){console.error(e.message);process.exit(0)}' 2>>"$LOG" || echo "OTHER")
  echo "$TOOLCHAIN" > "$WORKSPACE/logs/toolchain.txt"
  # restore node_modules using lockfile if missing
  if [ ! -d node_modules ]; then
    if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
      npm ci --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "npm ci failed; see $LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 9; }
    elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then
      yarn install --silent >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "yarn install failed; see $LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 10; }
    elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ] && command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      pnpm install --silent >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "pnpm install failed; see $LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 11; }
    else
      echo "No lockfile found; running npm install (non-deterministic)" >>"$LOG"
      npm i --no-audit --no-fund >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "npm install failed; see $LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 12; }
    fi
  fi
  # If toolchain is non-CRA, exit with log so later steps can adapt
  if [ "$(cat "$WORKSPACE/logs/toolchain.txt")" != "CRA" ]; then
    echo "Non-CRA toolchain detected: $(cat "$WORKSPACE/logs/toolchain.txt")" >>"$LOG"
    exit 0
  fi
fi
# If reach here nothing to do
exit 0

steps.name: Install project dev dependencies and configure tooling (lockfile-aware)
steps.description: Ensure project dev/testing tooling is present (jest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, msw, cross-env, dotenv, serve) but avoid installing jsdom by default (jest supplies jsdom). Respect package manager preference (npm/yarn/pnpm) and lockfiles: prefer npm ci / yarn install / pnpm install for deterministic installs. If we add missing dev deps, regenerate deterministic install (npm ci or yarn install) to update lockfile-consistent node_modules.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98494/Database"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
LOG="$WORKSPACE/logs/install.log"
: >"$LOG"
# Read package manager detected earlier
PM=$(cat "$WORKSPACE/logs/package_manager.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo npm)
TOOLCHAIN=$(cat "$WORKSPACE/logs/toolchain.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo UNKNOWN)
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then echo "package.json missing; cannot install dependencies" >>"$LOG"; exit 20; fi
# Define needed dev deps (avoid jsdom unconditionally)
NEEDED=("jest" "@testing-library/react" "@testing-library/jest-dom" "msw" "cross-env" "dotenv" "serve")
# Helper to check if package present (safe JS parser)
has_pkg(){ node -e "try{const j=require('./package.json');const deps=Object.assign({},j.dependencies||{},j.devDependencies||{});console.log(Boolean(deps['$1']));}catch(e){console.log(false)}" 2>>"$LOG" || echo false; }
MISSING=()
for pkg in "${NEEDED[@]}"; do
  if [ "$(has_pkg "$pkg")" != "true" ]; then MISSING+=("$pkg"); fi
done
# If missing dev deps, add via proper package manager
if [ ${#MISSING[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
  if [ "$PM" = "yarn" ]; then
    yarn add --dev "${MISSING[@]}" --silent >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "yarn add dev deps failed; see $LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 21; }
    # ensure deterministic install
    yarn install --silent >"$LOG" 2>&1 || true
  elif [ "$PM" = "pnpm" ] && command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    pnpm add -D "${MISSING[@]}" --silent >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "pnpm add dev deps failed; see $LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 22; }
    pnpm install --silent >"$LOG" 2>&1 || true
  else
    npm i --no-audit --no-fund --save-dev "${MISSING[@]}" >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "npm install dev deps failed; see $LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 23; }
    # regenerate deterministic node_modules
    if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
      npm ci --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund >"$LOG" 2>&1 || true
    fi
  fi
else
  # Prefer lockfile-based installs to ensure consistency
  if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
    npm ci --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "npm ci failed; see $LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 24; }
  elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then
    yarn install --silent >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "yarn install failed; see $LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 25; }
  elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ] && command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    pnpm install --silent >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "pnpm install failed; see $LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 26; }
  else
    npm i --no-audit --no-fund >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "npm install failed; see $LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 27; }
  fi
fi
# Ensure local jest binary is available (npx --no-install fallback)
if [ -x node_modules/.bin/jest ]; then
  node_modules/.bin/jest --version > "$WORKSPACE/logs/jest_version.log" 2>&1 || true
else
  if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx --no-install jest --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    npx --no-install jest --version > "$WORKSPACE/logs/jest_version.log" 2>&1 || true
  else
    echo "local jest binary not found and npx fallback unavailable" >>"$LOG"
  fi
fi
# Minimal ESLint/Prettier config if absent
[ -f .eslintrc.json ] || cat > .eslintrc.json <<'EOF'
{"extends":["react-app","plugin:prettier/recommended"]}
EOF
[ -f .prettierrc ] || cat > .prettierrc <<'EOF'
{"singleQuote":true}
EOF
# Light AI mock scaffold (JS by default)
mkdir -p src/mocks
[ -f src/mocks/aiMock.js ] || cat > src/mocks/aiMock.js <<'EOF'
// Minimal mock for image/AI endpoints used in development
export function predictImage(_input){ return Promise.resolve({ label:'mock-label', confidence:0.99 }); }
EOF
[ -f src/mocks/README.md ] || cat > src/mocks/README.md <<'EOF'
Enable mocks in development (import in src/index.js when NODE_ENV=development).
EOF
exit 0

steps.description: Build the application using the detected toolchain (CRA: npm run build, Vite/Next: corresponding build command). Then serve the static build in an isolated process group (setsid) and poll the server until responsive. Perform a basic HTML smoke check, record evidence to logs/validation.log and produce VALIDATION_OK on success. Ensure robust cleanup by killing the process group.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98494/Database"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
VALID_LOG="$WORKSPACE/logs/validation.log"
: >"$VALID_LOG"
PORT=5000
TOOLCHAIN=$(cat "$WORKSPACE/logs/toolchain.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo "UNKNOWN")
# Build according to toolchain
case "$TOOLCHAIN" in
  CRA)
    if ! npm run build >"$VALID_LOG" 2>&1; then echo "npm run build failed; see $VALID_LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$VALID_LOG" >&2; exit 40; fi
    BUILD_DIR=build
    ;;
  VITE)
    if ! npm run build >"$VALID_LOG" 2>&1; then echo "vite build failed; see $VALID_LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$VALID_LOG" >&2; exit 41; fi
    BUILD_DIR=dist
    ;;
  NEXT)
    if ! npm run build >"$VALID_LOG" 2>&1; then echo "next build failed; see $VALID_LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$VALID_LOG" >&2; exit 42; fi
    # Next produces .next and requires next start; we will attempt next start on a separate port for smoke
    BUILD_DIR=.next
    ;;
  *)
    echo "Unknown or unsupported toolchain ($TOOLCHAIN); attempting npm run build" >"$VALID_LOG"
    if ! npm run build >"$VALID_LOG" 2>&1; then echo "build failed; see $VALID_LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$VALID_LOG" >&2; exit 43; fi
    BUILD_DIR=build
    ;;
esac
# Ensure static build exists for static servers
if [ ! -d "$BUILD_DIR" ]; then echo "build output ($BUILD_DIR) not found after build" >&2; exit 44; fi
# Determine serve command: prefer local serve binary; else npx fallback (without --no-install) to allow install if available
if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/serve ]; then
  SERVE_CMD=("./node_modules/.bin/serve" "-s" "$BUILD_DIR" "-l" "$PORT")
else
  if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    SERVE_CMD=("npx" "serve" "-s" "$BUILD_DIR" "-l" "$PORT")
  else
    echo "serve not available (no local binary and no npx); cannot validate serve" >&2; exit 45
  fi
fi
# Start serve in its own session/process group to allow clean kill
setsid "${SERVE_CMD[@]}" >"$VALID_LOG" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
# Get PGID and ensure cleanup
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= $PID | tr -d ' ' || true)
trap 'if [ -n "${PGID:-}" ]; then kill -TERM -"$PGID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; wait $PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
# Wait up to 60s for server
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if curl -sSf "http://localhost:$PORT/" >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
  sleep 1
done
if ! curl -sSf "http://localhost:$PORT/" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Validation server did not start; see $VALID_LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$VALID_LOG" >&2 || true; exit 46
fi
# Smoke check for HTML
if ! curl -sSf "http://localhost:$PORT/" | grep -qi '<!doctype html\|<html'; then
  echo "Unexpected response from validation server" >&2; exit 47
fi
# Record evidence
printf "validation: ok\nnode=%s\nnpm=%s\npm_toolchain=%s\n" "$(node -v)" "$(npm -v)" "$TOOLCHAIN" > "$VALID_LOG"
echo "validation: ok" > "$WORKSPACE/VALIDATION_OK"
exit 0

Where the container already includes tools (create-react-app, yarn, pnpm, jest, eslint, prettier), scripts avoid reinstalling them and will surface version mismatches instead of reinstalling global tools.

change_logs.message: Refined plan to address analyst feedback: modified env-001 to avoid unsafe PATH writes and added Node/NPM version checks; updated scaffold-001 to improve idempotency, preserve logs, and avoid silencing errors; replaced deps-001 to use safe npm pkg operations and ensure test libs (@testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom) are present, create jest.config.js instead of overwriting package.json, add msw mock scaffold; renamed script_name for deps step to 'install' and added separate 'build' and 'start' steps; test-001 enhanced to verify App.js presence and not suppress diagnostics; validation-001 changed to serve the production build via 'serve' with improved timeouts and reliable cleanup. Added small mock file for AI/image endpoints. These changes address correctness, idempotency, security, and process lifecycle issues called out in the feedback.

Refined multiple steps to address analyst feedback: env-001 updated to check npm and npx, verify npm>=8 (for Node16/18), detect yarn availability, write /etc/profile.d react_dev_env.sh idempotently with safe permissions and produce env version log; scaffold-001 made deterministic: if workspace empty -> run CRA; if package.json exists but required scripts/deps missing -> attempt npm ci or yarn install using lockfile, else inspect package.json with node -e to detect CRA/react-scripts or other toolchains and fail with actionable remediation captured in scaffold.log; deps-001 now installs project-local jest (devDependency), uses npm ci when package-lock.json present or yarn install when yarn.lock present, validates presence of node_modules/.bin/jest and versions of testing libs, and improves idempotency checks by inspecting package.json devDependencies; test-001 now invokes project-local jest binary (node_modules/.bin/jest) with CI flags, creates smoke test only if App exists and avoids invoking global jest; validation-001 now asserts build/ exists before serving, runs ./node_modules/.bin/serve (fallback to npx --no-install), uses trap + pkill -P for cleanup, and records validation evidence and versions to workspace/validation.log. These changes address critical compatibility, idempotency, package-manager detection, and process lifecycle issues. Steps modified: env-001, scaffold-001, deps-001, test-001, validation-001.

Refined env-001, scaffold-001, deps-001, test-001, and validation-001 to address analyst feedback: removed deprecated npx flags and validated npx presence; made /etc/profile.d writes consistent and idempotent with sudo and export NODE_ENV only when unset while also creating a workspace .env.local file; added pnpm detection and explicit toolchain detection (CRA, Vite, Next, plain) and logged toolchain to workspace/logs/toolchain.txt; replaced brittle node -e JSON checks with try/catch JS snippets; removed unconditional jsdom install and rely on jest's jsdom, only adding jsdom if project explicitly requires it; ensured lockfile determinism by preferring npm ci / yarn install and by re-running deterministic installs after adding missing dev deps; test step now detects TypeScript and creates .test.tsx accordingly; validation step now isolates the serve process with setsid and kills the process group on cleanup; added clearer, actionable failure messages and ensured non-deprecated npx usage. These changes address CRITICAL and HIGH issues raised by the analyst and improve idempotency, safety, and toolchain correctness.
